“哎呀，不好，老子家里不光养了条狗，还养了好几条大蛇哪！
老子要是出来久了，这几条大蛇非出去惹是生非不可！”
打着打着，那紫面大汉忽然絮絮叨叨，跳出圈外。

((Page 22) In order to save trouble, Meteor directly destroyed his meridians, and also sealed his spiritual and magical powers.

Li Sheng was lost in memories. Li Yu snickered and was happy to see his brother lost his mind. He casually sat on a chair and waited for Li Sheng to speak.
Yunfu was frustrated here in Huyue, and those junior brothers tormented him everywhere under the guise of venting her anger.
No matter what happens, it must be mixed in, so that Hu Yue's days in the mountains are not as comfortable as staying outside.
The old sect leader glanced at the man and said, "Only Meishan understands the movement of the Ice Sword. Even if you don't succeed this time, do you think you have the ability to do this task better, or do you doubt my ability."
"Come here, take Hu Yue and lock her up."
Qing Ruifan was also suddenly shocked, and punished him without any explanation. Lan Yi called someone from behind, but Hu Yue didn't even refute and just followed him away obediently.
After saying these words, Black Tu Yuan Sheng's body completely turned into a point of light and disappeared. Perhaps even the last concern in the world disappeared.
He lowered his head, clenched his fists, his shoulders were trembling, and endless memories were tumbling in his brain. At the same time, the silent mask on his face began to pierce invisible claws into his brain. Severe pain swept through him, but it neutralized the bone-eroding humiliation. He had the strength to raise his head.
"Oh, no, I have not only a dog at home, but also several big snakes!
If I stay out for a long time, these big snakes will definitely go out and cause trouble! "
As he was beating, the purple-faced man suddenly started chattering and jumped out of the circle.
Because although there is no one around, this is still an urban area after all. If there is any disturbance, there will still be many professional onlookers rolling over at lightning speed to watch.
